questions.html:
Consider the following statements about the mesh architecture in the global clock distribution network.

A. It is highly reliable because multiple paths exist from the clock drivers to any point on the mesh.
B. It is impacted less by process-induced variations than the tree architecture.
C. It dissipates significant short-circuit power when the clock signal has skew at the inputs of the mesh drivers.

 Which of the above statements is/are correct?

Handing over the final IC layout to the foundry for fabrication.
